headline.title: Nvidia has already committed $40B to equity AI deals this year
headline.summary: Nvidia has invested $40 billion in equity deals related to artificial intelligence in 2023, reinforcing its position as a significant player in the AI ecosystem. This commitment highlights the company's ongoing strategy to expand its influence and capabilities in the rapidly evolving AI market.

articles.title: "OncoAgent: A Dual-Tier Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy-Preserving Oncology Clinical Decision Support"
articles.summary: Researchers have developed OncoAgent, a dual-tier multi-agent framework designed to enhance privacy-preserving clinical decision support in oncology. This innovative system aims to improve patient data security while facilitating effective cancer treatment recommendations.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman week 2: OpenAI fires back, and Shivon Zilis reveals that Musk tried to poach Sam Altman
articles.summary: In the ongoing trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk accused CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman of misleading him regarding his $38 million donation to the organization. Additionally, Shivon Zilis revealed that Musk attempted to recruit Altman away from OpenAI.

articles.title: Hackable Robot Lawn Mower Unlocks a New Nightmare
articles.summary: A newly discovered vulnerability in a robot lawn mower allows hackers to take control of the device, raising security concerns for users. In related news, Meta has discontinued encrypted direct messaging on Instagram, while leaked documents expose Russia's training program for elite hackers.

articles.title: ZAYA1-8B Technical Report
articles.summary: The ZAYA1-8B model, developed by Zyphra, is a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture featuring 700 million active parameters and a total of 8 billion parameters. It has demonstrated competitive performance on various mathematics and coding benchmarks, surpassing the DeepSeek-R1-0528 model while utilizing less than 1 billion active parameters.

articles.title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
articles.summary: The article introduces FinRAG-12B, a framework designed for training grounded domain-specific large language models (LLMs) in the banking sector, addressing challenges such as accuracy, regulatory compliance, and verifiable responses. This production-validated recipe aims to enhance answer quality and citation grounding while ensuring calibrated refusals in real-world applications.

articles.title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: The article introduces Skill1, a framework designed for the unified evolution of skill-augmented agents through reinforcement learning. It addresses the challenges of maintaining a persistent skill library by integrating the selection, execution, and distillation of skills into a cohesive system, improving the efficiency of skill utilization across tasks.

articles.title: ViTok-v2: Scaling Native Resolution Auto-Encoders to 5 Billion Parameters
articles.summary: The article discusses ViTok-v2, a new model that scales Vision Transformer (ViT) auto-encoders to 5 billion parameters, improving image reconstruction capabilities compared to traditional convolutional tokenizers. It addresses limitations in existing ViT tokenizers related to performance degradation outside training resolutions and the challenges of stable scaling due to reliance on adversarial losses.

articles.title: Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video
articles.summary: The article presents Tamaththul3D, which introduces high-quality 3D parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 Saudi Sign Language dataset, addressing the lack of specialized reconstruction methods for avatar generation in Arabic Sign Language. This work aims to enhance the representation and accessibility of sign language for approximately 400 million Arabic speakers globally.

articles.title: Two Steps Are All You Need: Efficient 3D Point Cloud Anomaly Detection with Consistency Models
articles.summary: A new study presents a method for efficient 3D point cloud anomaly detection using consistency models, addressing challenges in practical deployment on resource-constrained systems. The approach aims to enhance reliability and performance in high-throughput manufacturing environments, where effective quality assurance is critical.

articles.title: X-Voice: Enabling Everyone to Speak 30 Languages via Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
articles.summary: X-Voice is a multilingual zero-shot voice cloning model capable of replicating arbitrary voices and enabling speech in 30 languages, trained on a 420K-hour multilingual corpus. The model employs a two-stage training paradigm and uses the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) for unified representation, eliminating the need for complex preprocessing.

articles.title: When2Speak: A Dataset for Temporal Participation and Turn-Taking in Multi-Party Conversations for Large Language Models
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced When2Speak, a synthetic dataset designed to improve large language models' performance in multi-party conversations by focusing on the timing of speech interventions. The dataset aims to enhance conversational coherence by addressing the challenges of turn-taking and participation dynamics in group discussions.
